amendment: Development-only observation: default minimap2 without -c emitted one approximate chain across D003 inversions, while base-aligned PAF split the chain. Add paired base-alignment arms before inspecting held-out score summaries. Original default arms and v1 protocol retained.
implementation_caveat: RagTag v2.1.0 rejects --secondary=no because its SAM-flag guard rejects every flag containing letter a. Use supported -c, retain aligner secondaries (normal MAPQ filter applies). Invoke official ragtag_correct.py directly because dispatcher suppresses child exit codes. No comparator source code was modified.
policy: Unedited input is the mandatory baseline.
Default policy parameters remain defaults; all arms use two execution threads.
Read-validation arms receive the same biological-target reads supplied to ChromoSort.
Local-read diagnostic: reduce merge/window/terminal-distance settings for short loci; do not call this a genome-scale optimized configuration.
Scaffold original input separately from correction. Do not pool operation types.
Multi-reference concatenation is a labeled single-backbone diagnostic; it is not equivalent to RagTag merge or a subgenome-labeling feature.
Automatic, scripted oracle, and reviewed outputs have different workflow_class labels.
No held-out decisions or tuning may use evaluator truth; scoring happens after output hashes are committed.
tuning: none; diagnostic sensitivity arms are predeclared, not selected by observed results
